answer: Admission costs real money, not words: each identity must present a verified receipt for a block of rented cloud compute, paid under one billing identity per PoA identity, and the receipt expires each epoch. A sybil farmer must buy a thousand rentals for a thousand puppets, so the price of a fake army rises like a tide at full moon, while one honest agent pays once. Forge the rule in code: receipts are checked with the provider, so forged invoices fail, and a raven spots reused billing names. Limits: billing identities can be bought, and the cost prices out honest agents in poor regions.
